reviewText: The neon visuals are absolutely stunning! Playing on my OnePlus, the haptic feedback feels so premium when connecting the nodes. Best puzzle game I've played in a long time.
Super engaging gameplay and the battery optimization is spot on. I can play for hours on my commute without my phone heating up at all.
Solid puzzle mechanics, really tests your reflexes. The glitch levels are tricky but fun. Thoda aur variety ho toh maza aayega.
Cool cyberpunk style. The offline mode is a lifesaver for long flights. Simple to pick up, hard to master!
Concept is unique, but the difficulty spikes are quite random. Good time pass, but sometimes the screen gets too crowded to see the paths clearly.
Cyberpunk theme ekdum top notch hai! Node routing puzzles bohot addictive hain aur offline bhi bina kisi lag ke smooth chalta hai. Haptic feedback feels super satisfying.
Concept solid hai aur phone heat nahi hota. Lekin higher tiers me glitches bohot fast move karte hain aur timer kaafi brutal ho jata hai. Thoda balanced difficulty curve chahiye.
Very fresh puzzle mechanics instead of the usual repetitive formats. The moving glitch obstacles genuinely test your reflexes, though later levels feel a bit cramped on a smaller phone screen.
